- `current_frame.step` is the current environment step count.
- `current_frame.level` is the current level number.

def probe(tag,r,c):
    before=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    al=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    d=[(rr,cc,before[rr][cc],al[rr][cc]) for rr in range(64) for cc in range(64) if before[rr][cc]!=al[rr][cc]]
    gd=[x for x in d if x[0]!=1]
    print(tag, (gd[:8] if gd else 'no diff'), {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('done','level_completed')})
def tokpos():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']==14 and n['color']=='c':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rs),min(cs))
print('token',tokpos())
probe('box2yellow',56,21)
probe('box1yellow',58,9)
probe('ballcenter',58,46)
print('token',tokpos())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
